audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer merged two different abilities into one invented thing, 'the E mist-cage', and treated it as both the ranged poke and the box that traps you. Last Rites (Q) was never mentioned.
audit.why: Mourning Mist (E) is a 700-range globule that reduces armour, damages, slows and MARKS you — his summoned units gain move speed toward the marked target. Dark Procession (W) is the destructible wall that blocks movement, 600 range, 20/18/16/14/12s. They are separate abilities with separate cooldowns and separate answers: dodge the mark, do not stand where the wall can close. Last Rites (Q) is an auto-attack reset that heals him, 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s.
audit.corrected: Mourning Mist and Dark Procession separated everywhere with their own cooldowns; Last Rites written in as an auto-reset heal with the Grievous Wounds cue.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Ryze Level 1 while its why says Yorick zones you off the wave, gave Yorick Levels 3 and 4-5 where the whys describe an even CS race, gave Ryze Level 6 where the why says the 1v1 remains even, and gave Yorick First item where the why describes your kill-pressure window.
audit.why: Five of seven rows contradicted their own text. Yorick's early zone control, a long even midgame, then Ryze's mana-item window before Maiden takes over — the packet chart states exactly that, and 50.19% fits it.
audit.corrected: Yorick, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Ryze, Yorick — paired full/content rows with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appeared anywhere; the wall was treated as an ever-present threat.
audit.why: Dark Procession is 20 seconds at rank 1 and Mourning Mist 12 — those two numbers are the entire step-up schedule.
audit.corrected: Both written into the phases and the Do's.

edits.before: At level 1 Yorick's E mist-cage outranges your Q and you have no root yet — do not walk into the cage trying to CS under it or his ghouls will chunk you for free. Farm at max Q range and accept imperfect CS rather than eating a cage-plus-ghoul rotation. At level 2 you have W, but only use the root if he steps up without his E on hand; a rooted Yorick with E already down is a real damage window, a rooted Yorick who immediately cages you back just trades even. Level 3 is your first genuine threat: E him to apply Flux, W root before he can place the cage, then empowered Q for the cascade — his base resistances are low and a full Flux cycle hurts, but back off immediately before his ghouls stack up.
edits.after: At level 1 Mourning Mist reaches 700 and marks you, and his ghouls gain move speed sprinting at whatever it marked — do not stand in the wave trying to CS through it or they chunk you for free. Farm at max Q range and accept imperfect CS rather than eating a mark-plus-ghoul rotation. At level 2 you have W, but only root him when Mourning Mist is spent; a rooted Yorick with it down is a real damage window, a rooted Yorick who walls you in with Dark Procession just trades even. Level 3 is your first genuine threat: E to apply Flux, W root before the wall lands, then empowered Q for the cascade — but back off before his ghouls stack up.

notes: The inherited 'E mist-cage' was one invented ability standing in for two real ones, which made the level-2 advice actively wrong: the page told the player to root only when 'his E' is down, when the thing that punishes a root is the W wall. Both cooldowns are now stated separately. Yorick's Maiden timing ('level 11', 'permanent presence') is inherited and not verifiable from the kit — left untouched. Last Rites' heal amount and whether Dark Procession's wall blocks Ryze's Q projectile are not in Riot's text; nothing was asserted about either.
